name: grasso_screw_rpm_efficiencies
title: Example: Grasso screw isentropic efficiencies at two speeds
summary: Example from the Laborelec 2002 toolkit. Polynomial isentropic efficiencies of four Grasso screw compressors (C-52, H-5, N-5 and S-51) are evaluated at one pressure ratio and scaled from 2940 rpm to 1500 rpm.

verification.summary: Compared with the EES stored solution of Example-Grasso Screw RPM General Simulation.EES by compare_solution.py without --ees-units: 12 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 0; only in CoolSolve: 0. Largest relative difference 7.29e-11 on epsilon_s_C_52_1500rpm. All 12 equations are satisfied.
verification.reference: EES stored solution of thermo_models TM-0287 (Example-Grasso Screw RPM General Simulation.EES, EES X6.596, 12/12); tools/compare_solution.py, no unit conversion (stored unit strings are blank; the window has no pressure and no energy)
verification.notes: compare_solution.py --all prints 7.29e-11 on epsilon_s_C_52_1500rpm. Unrounded, that relative difference is 7.285524e-11, the maximum over the 12 common variables. The EES value is stored as 0.6533508484 and CoolSolve gives 0.6533508484476. The other three 1500 rpm efficiencies print 4.21e-11 (H-5), 3.16e-11 (N-5) and 2.93e-11 (S-51). A run with --ees-units converted no reference value. R_P = 5.4 was added so the window is square; the braced guess {R_P=1} was not used as the value. No input was multiplied by 1000.
